title: Man With Attitude Meets No Nonsense Cop
description:
On November 12th, 2022, an officer noticed a suspicious silver SUV and ran its licence plate number in the records. He found that the driver had a suspended licence and a warrant issued in his name as well. He initiated a pursuit, but the driver kept speeding away. As soon as the officer asked for the driver’s name, the driver began acting difficult and did not comply. This prompted the officer to take strict action. The officers were successful in detaining the suspect, but he continued to resist and escalate the situation, which did not sit well with the officers. Even though the officer was trying to make him understand the situation, the suspect wasn’t ready to listen to it and continued to defend himself. Shortly after, dispatch advised that the individual indeed had a warrant issued in his name. The officer tried to reason with the suspect and explain the purpose of the stop. Soon, his girlfriend arrived at the scene and was briefed by the officer. He tried explaining his situation to the female. The man had a previous warrant and received citations for suspended registration, no proof of insurance, and driving with a suspended license. Additionally, he was charged with concealing identity, resisting arrest, and obstructing justice.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
